artless.definition:
a. simple and natural; without cunning or deceit
s. showing lack of art
s. (of persons) lacking art or knowledge
artless.translation: a. 无虚饰的, 单纯的, 自然的

artlessly.definition:
r. in a crude and unskilled manner
r. in an ingenuous manner
artlessly.translation: adv. 天真烂漫地, 淳朴地

artlessness.definition:
n. the quality of innocent naivete
n. ingenuousness by virtue of being free from artful deceit
artlessness.translation: n. 天真烂漫；淳朴；笨拙
